The '''Shipping Master''' of [[Kwilaan Starport/Legends|Kwilaan Starport]] in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]] was visited by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The spacer was searching for two cases of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] candy on behalf of the [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Saun Dann]], and the Shipping Master directed the spacer to the city of [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
